Results.ReviewText: I knew that Weber was a safe and reliable brand, so I treated myself to an early birthday present. Glad I did.  This grill gets almost daily use.  My only criticism is that the small canisters of propane are very difficult to install. I bought the hose to allow me to use a regular propane bottle. You get what you pay for - and this grill is worth every penny.
Results.Title: Easy to use

Results.ReviewText: I had been looking at this product for awhile. I was using an old small grill in my 5th wheel but bought this while on a trip. I was only able to use it a couple of times so far but loved it.
Results.Title: Great item

Results.ReviewText: Have been cooking on the grill for a few months now.  Have been really happy with the grill.   It seems to cook everything well.  My only complaint  is that the majority of the accessories are only offered in Australia, not the U.S.
Results.Title: Awesome little grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Easy to use and easy to assemble. Great quality
Results.Title: Great Grill A++++

Results.ReviewText:
I have had this a few months but this is my second one of these. The first one is still working great. Got this as a dedicated RV grill. Heats quickly, cooks evenly cleans up easily. It’s a grest size for us, but there is the 2000 series if you need bigger. I love the color choices too. Original was orange to match our Jeep, this one is purple. 
Thrilled with this purchase.
Results.Title: Great portable grill

Results.ReviewText: Used now for 6+months at home at with our camper. Grills great steaks as well as hamburgers, fish, chops and veggies. Get over 5 grilling's with one gas cylinder. Highly recommend this compact grill.
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this last summer for Friday night picnics to the beach. Works great! Quickly packs into the car and is ready in minutes when we get there. Cooks evenly and consistency.
Results.Title: Just what I expected from Weber

Results.ReviewText: Very hard to control heat.burners clogging up,tank attachments very flimsy.
Results.Title: Weber grilling

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! We are sorry to hear that your food is sticking to the cooking grates! To help prevent sticking, we recommend preheating your grill with the burner on high for 10-15 minutes before putting your food on and oiling your food rather than the grate. This helps to release the food from the cooking grate when it is time to flip halfway through cooking. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Mike

Results.ReviewText:
I can cook on a variety of grills and get good results. What I liked about the Weber is the heavy construction and the fact it came with a built in thermometer that makes it easier to get great results every time. This grill is worth a repair if something wears out.  Love the grill. 

I do wish they didn’t coat the cooking grates with porcelain.  Food sticks to that surface badly.  Stainless or straight cast iron would make this grill even better. Still it’s worth the money for a grill that could easily last 20 years. Even following strict guidelines on how to cook on porcelain doesn’t keep food from sticking. The grates are why it doesn’t get 5 stars.
Results.Title: Made to last!

Results.ReviewText: I easily transport it between my home and weekend cabin, Love this grill !
Results.Title: Very portable

Results.ReviewText: We bought this to take camping. It cooks great and is easy to clean. We love it!
Results.Title: Great small grill

Way to go Weber.

Results.Title: Love it!

Grill has cooked everything great so far.
, I wish I had bought it years. I like the portability too.
Results.Title: Should have purchased sooner

Results.ReviewText: Had it now for several months & I'm very pleased. It's so easy to operate & cooks very well.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Bought a Q1200 last year in Mesa. Have had a series of grills over the years that have performed OK.  Each had drawbacks and it seemed like grilling on these grills was one compromise after another.

I think I've died and gone to grilling heaven since I got this wonderful grill.  We bought it specifically to keep on our RV while traveling.  But it is so fundamentally excellent it comes home with us and has replaced our Big Grill for everyday grilling.  We grill about 200 days per year at least.  

What a workhorse.  Love it.  Just the right size for two or four folks.

Great job Weber!

You continue to exceed our expectations.
Results.Title: This little marvel is my new "Go To Grill"

Results.ReviewText: As a tiny older woman this grill is so perfect for me...it's safe, easy to start, and easy to clean. it is light enough to effortlessly move locations. Worth EVERY penny !!!!
Results.Title: LOVE MY WEBER !!!

Results.ReviewText: I've had this Q1200 now for almost a year and a half and have moved a couple states with it. It's perfect for all occasions and can be stored anywhere! I recommend getting the optional stand, it makes it easy to move around especially for tailgating!
Results.Title: Versatile

Results.ReviewText: Bought the Q before heading out on a two month camping trip.  Excellent results every time we used it.  Fits nicely in the storage bin under the RV.  Saw quite a few during our trip.
Results.Title: Great rv grill

Results.ReviewText: I had a friend who used this bbq. I was amazed at how well it cooked and gave a real bbq flavor to what ever was cooked. I bought mine a month ago . I lam a full time retired rv’er. I love the continence and it helps keep the inside of RV clean!
Results.Title: Fantastic!!

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, clean and store. Have one in MI and one inFL
Results.Title: Perfect !

Results.ReviewText: We’re full time RVer’s and our Weber is perfect for our lifestyle. It’s small and lightweight but performs like a much bigger more expensive grill. Very happy with the service department at Weber. We’ve had numerous high end Webers in the past and will continue to use Weber in the future.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this in the summer of 17,use it all the time even in winter...it dont matter how hard the wind blows,it has never blown out as it did alot with other brands.And the grates are incredible.this should last many years
Results.Title: Wind dont matter

Results.ReviewText: Really enjoy this little grill. It sips propane and provides a nice char on meats. The only downside is we have the light colored lid and it is difficult to get the smoke stains off. Would buy this again in a heartbeat though! Just get one with a darker lid!

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this last summer and used it in our motor home.  Perfect size and works great!
Results.Title: Love this little guy!

Results.Title: Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: It's almost the perfect compact grill. Little to no flare ups. Cooks even for a small grill. Only thing that needs improvement is that it doesn't have enough low end gas flow. I have to use the tank valve for that.
Results.Title: Pretty sweet

Results.ReviewText: Purchased the Q1200 primarily for use in our RV travels. Has exceeded our expectations in all respects.Quickly heats up and controls the temperature very well. Stores easily without any disassembly.
Results.Title: Excellent product

Results.ReviewText: I operated a Weber Genesis full size gas grill for more than 20 years.  After moving into a condo I needed not only a new grill but one that was more convenient to store and move.  The Weber Q1200 has been perfect!  Same fine Weber quality where pieces fit properly and all functions are as promised!  I hooked up a 20lb propane bottle and gas usage is much less.  I grill often and a tank has lasted six months!  The new Weber is easy to clean and maintain and from steaks to cold smoking meats the grill is perfect!
Results.Title: A Typical Fine Weber Product

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill as I was thinking what a waste to fire up my big Weber grill for just 2 hamburgers or 2 steaks. What I didn’t know was how great the Q grill would be. It heats up fast, I love the cast iron grills that I can remove and wash in the sink! I ended up gettin the accessorie fuel line to hook it up to a larger propane tank and I use this all the time now except when we have picnics
Results.Title: My best purchase

Results.ReviewText: Purchased for tailgating and the grill fits my needs perfectly and preforms exceptionally well
Results.Title: Fills the bill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this about a year ago.   I love how easy it is to use and to clean.  I can actually take the grills out and put them in the kitchen sink if needed. (Or dishwasher!)  I also love it's size.    Not fond of the idea of  having a huge piece of equipment the size of a kitchen stove!
Results.Title: Love It!

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. Quick heat up. Great cooking surface and easy to clean when needed. Gets rather greasy underneath grill are where drippings go but overall, much better than using a large grill.
Results.Title: Great for small family

Results.ReviewText: This is an all around great portable grill, I’ve used on camping trips, tailgates, and the backyard and it tackles everything.
Results.Title: Great portable tailgate grill

Results.ReviewText: This is our 2nd Weber Q1200.  We purchased one while on vacation for a friend and liked it so much we had to get one for our own home. Best part is the easy cleanup!!
Results.Title: Best purchase!
